data.description: Pet-Friendly Residences with Pool, Gym & Park Access
data.long_description:
Olbia Town Square is a residential project by Nshama, located in the vibrant Town Square community. The development features a modern building comprising a ground floor, two podium levels, and ten residential floors. It offers a diverse selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Situated adjacent to The Promenade—a lively, green-lined walkway filled with boutique shops and cozy cafes—the project fosters a dynamic and community-focused lifestyle.

The building's architecture is modern, with clean lines and elegant proportions. The exterior combines glass elements and geometric forms, highlighting the urban character of the project, while panoramic windows fill the living spaces with natural light. Interiors are designed for maximum comfort, harmoniously blending functionality and aesthetics to create a cozy and relaxing atmosphere.

Residents have access to a swimming pool, a modern gym, barbecue areas, children's playgrounds, and a pet care facility. Proximity to the main park makes outdoor leisure especially enjoyable.

The complex's location allows a 20-minute drive to Dubai Hills Mall and District 2020, 24-25 minutes to Burj Al Arab and DWC Airport, 28 minutes to Dubai International Airport, and 29 minutes to The Dubai Mall.
